SourceTree.title: Sources
SourceTree.clearAllDescription: With no sources selected, the model can't show sources for the questions you ask. You can switch back to "all" any time.

HomePage.title: Vault Agent Toolkit
HomePage.emptyDescription: Create a vault first so you can chat with your notes — once you connect your Obsidian vault, its contents become searchable here.

VaultChatListPage.inputPlaceholder: Type a question... (Enter: start, Shift+Enter: new line)
VaultChatListPage.noSourcesDescription: For your questions to get source-grounded, citable answers, you first need to import notes from your Obsidian vault — otherwise every question comes back "out of scope".
VaultChatListPage.deleteChatDescription: This chat and all its messages will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

SettingsPage.defaultModelHint: For background tasks like title generation
SettingsPage.installedModelsHint: Models installed in Ollama. Use the field below to download a new one.
SettingsPage.modelListError: Couldn't get the model list — is Ollama running?
SettingsPage.pullModelHint: Pull a model from the Ollama library (e.g. qwen3:8b, llama3.2).
SettingsPage.allowConcurrentGenerationHint: Off by default — quiz/card/report/map/slide generation waits for an existing generation of the same type to finish before starting a new one, so they don't all slow each other down on weaker hardware. Turn this on if your hardware can handle it.
SettingsPage.showWelcomeScreen: Show the welcome screen on every launch
SettingsPage.showWelcomeScreenHint: Turning this off opens the app straight into the vault picker.
SettingsPage.desktopVaultDescription: This is the vault the app will open into on its next launch — not the currently active one (see the "Vaults" card below). The change takes effect on the next app launch (the vault path can't be changed while the server is running).
SettingsPage.vaultsCardDescription: Switch between multiple libraries, create or delete a vault.
SettingsPage.libraryCardDescription: Import from an Obsidian vault, upload settings.
SettingsPage.skillsCardDescription: Customize chat, quiz, and flashcard generation.
SettingsPage.providersCardDescription: Ollama and cloud providers (DeepSeek, ...), API keys, task chains.
SettingsPage.smallTalkCardDescription: Phrases learned so greetings and small talk do not trigger a source search.
SettingsPage.deleteModelConfirmDescription: This model will be permanently removed from Ollama. Downloaded files are deleted from disk.

LibrarySettingsPage.title: Library
LibrarySettingsPage.importObsidianDescription: Copies an Obsidian vault one-way (the source is never written to). Wikilinks are converted to relative markdown links, attachments are copied, and notes missing frontmatter fields get a default value plus a review badge.
LibrarySettingsPage.keepOriginals: Keep the original files of converted documents ({path})
LibrarySettingsPage.allowedLanguagesHint: The first language becomes the model's primary response language. Additional languages (e.g. for a language-learning vault) may appear in the response and aren't flagged as corruption by the leak detector.
LibrarySettingsPage.hiddenFolders: Folders hidden in the chat screen
LibrarySettingsPage.hiddenFoldersHint: These root folders never appear in the chat's source tree and are never offered as a source to any generation (chat, quiz, report, ...). The Library Tree (below) is unaffected.
LibrarySettingsPage.flattenFolders: Folders flattened in the chat screen
LibrarySettingsPage.flattenFoldersHint: These root folders themselves are hidden; the folders beneath them are shown directly at the tree's root instead. Paths are unchanged — only the tree's appearance is simplified.
LibrarySettingsPage.libraryTreeDescription: Upload, rename, or delete documents. The chat screen's own source tree (Faz 9) uses a separate, read-only copy of this for scope selection instead.

ProvidersSettingsPage.title: Model Providers
ProvidersSettingsPage.intro: Manage the local Ollama and optional cloud providers (DeepSeek, OpenAI, ...). Keys stay on the server in {path} and are never sent to the browser.
ProvidersSettingsPage.keyDeleteConfirmDescription: The API key saved for this provider will be permanently deleted.
ProvidersSettingsPage.providerDeleteConfirmDescription: This provider and its saved API key will be permanently deleted. It's also removed from every task chain.
ProvidersSettingsPage.chainSectionDescription: Providers tried in order for each task type. If the first provider can't respond (network error, timeout), the next one is tried — a permanent error like a bad API key doesn't trigger a switch.
ProvidersSettingsPage.defaultModelUpdateFailed: Couldn't update the default model for "{label}".
ProvidersSettingsPage.noModelList: no model list — test the connection

SmallTalkSettingsPage.title: Small-talk phrases
SmallTalkSettingsPage.intro: Greetings, slang and test messages get no sources. This lists what you taught and what was learned automatically; built-in examples appear only if switched off. Delete anything learned by mistake.
SmallTalkSettingsPage.loadError: Could not load the phrase list.
SmallTalkSettingsPage.clearConfirm: Delete everything learned and switch the built-in examples back on?

SkillsSettingsPage.title: User Skills
SkillsSettingsPage.intro: is where markdown files customize chat, quiz, and flashcard generation. Math formatting and source-verification rules always apply last — a skill can't override them.
SkillsSettingsPage.empty: No skills yet. The examples in "_examples/" ship disabled — edit and enable them if you'd like.

VaultsSettingsPage.title: Vaults
VaultsSettingsPage.intro: Each vault keeps its own source library and search index — they never mix. Chat history is split per vault, and the chat screen always operates on the active vault.
VaultsSettingsPage.deleteConfirmWithChats: Its library, search index, and {chatCount} chats will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
VaultsSettingsPage.deleteConfirmNoChats: Its library, search index, and chat history (none) will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

QuizStudyPage.submitFailed: Couldn't submit the quiz. Try again.

MindmapStudyPage.mapHint: Click a node's circle to expand/collapse it; click a truncated explanation to see the full text.
